Everything You Need to Run a BPO In One Place

Operoza is designed for real call center workflows, not generic CRM use cases.

Configurable Campaigns

Build campaigns from templates or from scratch, with the exact fields and pipeline your operation needs - no code required.

Leads, Sales & Agent Performance

Track every lead through to a sale, and see who is working, who is closing, and who needs support right now.

Call Analysis

Upload call audio and get sentiment, compliance, and summary analysis on every recorded interaction.

Payroll & Commission

Base salary, attendance-based deductions, and flat/percentage/tiered commission - computed automatically, even across campaigns in different currencies.

Dashboards & Reports

Configurable dashboards and formula-driven reports, with scheduled delivery and CSV/XLSX/PDF export.

Client Portal

Give clients their own scoped view of campaign performance - without exposing the rest of your operation.

Role-Based Access Control

Give the right access to admins, team leads, agents, HR, and clients, with clear boundaries enforced everywhere.

Attendance & Workforce

Shift-based attendance, exception handling, and network-based sign-in restrictions for your agents.

Data Security

Your Customer Data Is Yours Alone

A call center's customer data - names, health detail, financial and payment information - is the entire business. Every Operoza workspace is isolated so that data never touches another tenant's, in any form.

Isolated at the Data Layer

Your workspace's data is scoped to your tenant on every single query - not just hidden in the interface. No other business on Operoza can see it, ever.

Access Enforced by Role, on the Server

Admin, Team Lead, Agent, HR Manager, and Client each get exactly the access their role allows - checked on every API request, not just hidden menu items.

Every Sensitive Action Logged

User changes, role changes, and network access changes are recorded with who did it and when - visible to your own Admin.

See Exactly How Your Data Is Protected
